nativeResolutionLabel: 1 arc-second (~30.9 m N-S x 28.2 m E-W)

imagery.attribution: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
imagery.note: Georeferenced RGB optical overlay matched to geographic extent; acquisition date varies by mosaic tile.

provenance.processingPerformed: Bounded subset extraction via HTTP range read and bilinear reprojection from EPSG:4326 (1 arcsec) to 30.0 m EPSG:32719 UTM Zone 19S grid.
provenance.resamplingMethod: Bilinear interpolation onto 30.0 m metric grid
provenance.limitations: Digital Surface Model (DSM) including surface structures/vegetation where present rather than bare-earth DTM; ~30 m horizontal resolution resolves macro-landforms but not sub-meter rover obstacles.
